bugs.title: LED State Not Following Button Press
bugs.description: The LED state does not follow the button press as required, remaining LOW for extended periods. Measured evidence indicates D13 was not HIGH for 48 ms while required, first at 901.5 ms, across multiple intervals. D13 was in the wrong state for 721 ms across 15 interval(s), first at 902 ms: D13 was not HIGH for 48 ms while required (grace 100 ms).

bugs.title: Blinking Failure on D4 Press
bugs.description: The firmware fails to blink the LED within the required time frame when D4 is pressed. Measured evidence shows D13 missed 15 of 15 triggers, with the first violation occurring at 801.5 ms, indicating it did not start within 100 ms of the trigger. D13 missed 15 of 15 trigger(s): D13 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 802 ms.

bugs.title: Fan State Toggle Excessive
bugs.description: The fan toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window due to sensor noise at the threshold, indicating a lack of hysteresis in the control logic. This is evidenced by the measurement stating 'D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s'. D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s (limit 2), and 64 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

bugs.root_cause: The fan toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window due to sensor noise at the threshold, indicating a lack of hysteresis in the control logic. This is evidenced by the measurement stating 'D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s'.

bugs.title: Fan Not Forced ON During Fault
bugs.description: The fan did not enter the safe state when the temperature reading was below 5.0 °C, remaining OFF for 5400 ms during a sensor disconnection. This is shown by the measurement 'D9 not HIGH for 5400 ms during fault'. During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 5400 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).
bugs.evidence: During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 5400 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).
bugs.root_cause: The fan did not enter the safe state when the temperature reading was below 5.0 °C, remaining OFF for 5400 ms during a sensor disconnection. This is shown by the measurement 'D9 not HIGH for 5400 ms during fault'.

bugs.title: Fan State Change Limit Exceeded
bugs.description: The fan toggled 7 times in a 5000 ms window due to button bounce and rapid presses on D4, violating the requirement of no more than 2 state changes. This is evidenced by the measured data showing 7 toggles starting at 1.00 s. D5 toggled 7 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.00 s (limit 2), and 8 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

bugs.root_cause: The fan toggled 7 times in a 5000 ms window due to button bounce and rapid presses on D4, violating the requirement of no more than 2 state changes. This is evidenced by the measured data showing 7 toggles starting at 1.00 s.
